verdict.rationale: Conductor is a Mac app that orchestrates coding agents in parallel workspaces, so debugging a live app from the assistant is a fair axis. The evidence only shows adjacent features: per-workspace terminals and running environments, port forwarding, and agents that run builds and tests. Nothing documents attaching to, inspecting, or debugging a live running web application from the agent.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug a live running web application directly from my coding assistant
